calibration_note: These thresholds are an initial proposal. Calibrate them with labeled samples and analyst feedback before raising autonomy. Confidence is not a measured accuracy.

growth.track: Count analyst verdicts (agent was correct / agent was wrong, plus the earlier confirm / correct decisions) for this ruleset version.
growth.raise_autonomy_only_after: A reviewed evaluation on labeled samples, then an edited policy file. One correction never changes a threshold, and the running engine never edits this file.
growth.mvp_limit: Nothing auto-executes. Every offered action waits for an explicit human yes.

action_labels.analyst_review: Keep this case in analyst review

rules.summary: High confidence and a likely_malicious label. Recommend simulated quarantine. A human must click Yes before the simulation is recorded.
The malicious label is only medium confidence. An analyst reviews the case before any containment recommendation is accepted.
The malicious label is low confidence. Investigate manually. No containment action is offered.
Suspicious mail stays with an analyst even when confidence is high. Quarantine is not offered for this label.
Medium confidence and a suspicious label. Analyst review is required.
Low confidence. Investigate manually instead of accepting a containment recommendation.
Aligning signals support likely_benign. A human may close the case with no containment. The engine does not auto-close it.
likely_benign is capped so it does not read as certainty. Closing still requires a human yes.
The benign label is low confidence. Investigate manually. Do not treat the label as a clearance.
The engine did not reach a firm verdict. Investigate manually. This is not a benign clearance.
